opportunities.name: Plan a literature unit: a public-domain novel on Gutenberg and its film adaptation on IMDb
opportunities.description: In the Project Gutenberg tab, click the search box, type "{book}" and press Enter -> Open the matching book and note its author and its download count from the bibliographic record -> Switch to the IMDb tab, click the search box, type "{book}" and press Enter; open the first film adaptation and note its year and IMDb rating -> Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Unit: {book} by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>" and press Enter
steps: In the Project Gutenberg tab, click the search box, type "{book}" and press Enter
Open the matching book and note its author and its download count from the bibliographic record
Switch to the IMDb tab, click the search box, type "{book}" and press Enter; open the first film adaptation and note its year and IMDb rating
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Unit: {book} by <author> (<downloads> downloads). Film: <year>, rated <rating>" and press Enter

opportunities.name: Prepare a geography fact card from Wikipedia and the capital's local time
opportunities.description: In the Wikipedia tab, click the search box, type {country} and open the country article -> From the infobox, note the population, official language(s) and currency -> Switch to the timeanddate tab, click the search box, type {capital}, press Enter and open its current local time page; note the time -> Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Geography: {country}, capital {capital}, pop <population>, <language>, <currency>, time now <time>" and press Enter
steps: In the Wikipedia tab, click the search box, type {country} and open the country article
From the infobox, note the population, official language(s) and currency
Switch to the timeanddate tab, click the search box, type {capital}, press Enter and open its current local time page; note the time
Switch to Notes, click "New note", type "Geography: {country}, capital {capital}, pop <population>, <language>, <currency>, time now <time>" and press Enter
